title: 複合リンク式ボルトクリッパー
description: 工場や建設作業場の工具棚/作業台に置く大型ボルトクリッパー。直線の対向切断刃と厚い鍛造風ジョウ、二軸の表裏ブリッジ、交差する短い複合リンク、調整ナットとストップねじ、長い二本の金属ハンドル、閉じた端と滑り止めの黒い握りを造形。剪定ばさみとは異なる直線の対向刃を少し開いた固定姿勢です。刃/リンク/ハンドルの動作、実際の切断、刃硬度や安全性能は再現していません。全部品を含む一式1点。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.320 × 0.059 × 0.581 m、21,744三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: Large bolt cutters for factory or construction workshop shelving and benches. Straight opposing cutting edges and thick forged-style jaws, front/rear twin-pivot bridge plates, short crossed compound links, adjustment nuts/stop screw, long twin metal handles, closed grip ends and ribbed black grips are modeled. Unlike bypass pruning shears, the straight opposing jaws have a narrow fixed opening. Jaw, linkage and handle motion, actual cutting, edge hardness and safety performance are not implemented. All components form one complete static prop. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.320 × 0.059 × 0.581 m; 21,744 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
